verses.he: וּקְרָא לְמשֶׁה וּמַלֵּיל יְיָ עִמֵּיהּ מִמַּשְׁכַּן זִמְנָא לְמֵימָר:
verses.en: And He called to Moshe, and Adonoy spoke to him from the Tent of Meeting, saying:

verses.he: מַלֵּיל עִם בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל וְתֵימַר לְהוֹן אֱנַשׁ אֲרֵי יְקָרֵיב מִנְּכוֹן קֻרְבָּנָא קֳדָם יְיָ מִן בְּעִירָא מִן תּוֹרֵי וּמִן עָנָא תְּקָרְבוּן יָת קֻרְבַּנְכוֹן:
verses.en: Speak to Bnei Yisroel and say to them; [if] a man among you will bring an offering to [before] Adonoy; of animals, cattle or sheep you should bring your offering.

verses.he: אִם עֲלָתָא קֻרְבָּנֵיהּ מִן תּוֹרֵי דְּכַר שְׁלִים יְקָרְבִנֵּיהּ לִתְרַע מַשְׁכַּן זִמְנָא יְקָרֵב יָתֵיהּ לְרַעֲוָא לֵיהּ קֳדָם יְיָ:
verses.en: If his offering is a burnt-offering of cattle he shall bring an unblemished male; to the entrance of the Tent of Meeting he shall bring it, that it be favorably accepted from him before Adonoy.

verses.he: וְיִסְמוֹךְ יְדֵיהּ עַל רֵישׁ עֲלָתָא וְיִתְרְעֵי לֵיהּ לְכַפָּרָא עֲלוֹהִי:
verses.en: He shall lay his hand on the head of the burnt-offering and it will be favorably accepted from him to achieve his atonement.

verses.he: וְיִכּוֹס יָת בַּר תּוֹרֵי קֳדָם יְיָ וִיקָרְבוּן בְּנֵי אַהֲרֹן כָּהֲנַיָּא יָת דְּמָא וְיִזְרְקוּן יָת דְּמָא עַל מַדְבְּחָא סְחוֹר סְחוֹר דִּי בִתְרַע מַשְׁכַּן זִמְנָא:
verses.en: He shall slaughter the calf before Adonoy and the sons of Aharon, the kohanim, will bring the blood and they will sprinkle the blood all around the altar, which is at the entrance of the Tent of Meeting.

verses.he: וְיַשְׁלַח יָת עֲלָתָא וִיפַלֵּג יָתַהּ לְאֶבְרָהָא:
verses.en: He shall skin the burnt-offering and cut it into its pieces [limbs].

verses.he: וְיִתְּנוּן בְּנֵי אַהֲרֹן כַּהֲנָא אֶשָּׁתָא עַל מַדְבְּחָא וִיסַדְּרוּן אָעַיָּא עַל אֶשָּׁתָא:
verses.en: The sons of Aharon the kohein shall place [ignite] a fire on the altar and they shall arrange logs on the fire.

verses.he: וִיסַדְּרוּן בְּנֵי אַהֲרֹן כָּהֲנַיָּא יָת אֶבְרַיָּא יָת רֵישָׁא וְיָת תַּרְבָּא עַל אָעַיָּא דִּי עַל אֶשָׁתָא דִּי עַל מַדְבְּחָא:
verses.en: The sons of Aharon, the kohanim, shall arrange the pieces [limbs], the head and the fat on the logs which are on the fire that is on the altar.

verses.he: וְגַוֵיהּ וּכְרָעוֹהִי יְחַלֵּל בְּמַיָּא וְיַסֵּק כַּהֲנָא יָת כּוֹלָא לְמַדְבְּחָא עֲלָתָא קֻרְבַּן דְּמִתְקַבֵּל בְּרַעֲוָא קֳדָם יְיָ:
verses.en: He shall wash its innards and its legs in water; and the kohein shall burn it all on the altar [for the purpose of] a burnt-offering, a fire-offering [an offering] of pleasing fragrance to [which is accepted with favor before] Adonoy.

verses.he: וְאִם מִן עָנָא קֻרְבָּנֵיהּ מִן אִמְּרַיָּא אוֹ מִן בְּנֵי עִזַיָּא לַעֲלָתָא דְּכַר שְׁלִים יְקָרְבִינֵיהּ:
verses.en: If his offering is from flocks of sheep—of lambs or of goats—for a burnt-offering, he shall bring an unblemished male.

verses.he: וְיִכּוֹס יָתֵיהּ עַל צִדָּא דְמַדְבְּחָא צִפּוּנָא קֳדָם יְיָ וְיִזְרְקוּן בְּנֵי אַהֲרֹן כָּהֲנַיָּא יָת דְּמֵיהּ עַל מַדְבְּחָא סְחוֹר סְחוֹר:
verses.en: He shall slaughter it on the north side of the altar before Adonoy; and the sons of Aharon, the kohanim, will sprinkle its blood all around the altar.

verses.he: וִיפַלֵּג יָתֵיהּ לְאֵבָרוֹהִי וְיָת רֵישֵׁיהּ וְיָת תַּרְבֵּיהּ וְיַסְדַּר כַּהֲנָא יָתְהוֹן עַל אָעַיָּא דִּי עַל אֶשָּׁתָא דִּי עַל מַדְבְּחָא:
verses.en: He shall sever it into its pieces [limbs]—and its head, and [remove] its fats; and the kohein shall arrange them on the logs which are on the fire that is on the altar.

verses.he: וְגַוָּא וּכְרָעַיָּא יְחַלֵּל בְּמַיָּא וִיקָרֵב כַּהֲנָא יָת כּוֹלָא וְיַסֵּק לְמַדְבְּחָא עֲלָתָא הוּא קֻרְבַּן דְּמִתְקַבֵּל בְּרַעֲוָא קֳדָם יְיָ:
verses.en: He shall wash the innards and feet in water and the kohein shall bring it all and burn it on the altar. It is a burnt-offering; a fire-offering [an offering] of pleasing fragrance to [which is accepted with favor before] Adonoy.

verses.he: וְאִם מִן עוֹפָא עֲלָתָא קֻרְבָּנֵיהּ קֳדָם יְיָ וִיקָרֵב מִן שַׁפְנִינַיָּא אוֹ מִן בְּנֵי יוֹנָה יָת קֻרְבָּנֵיהּ:
verses.en: If his burnt-offering to [before] Adonoy is of fowl, he shall bring either turtledoves or the young pigeons [as] his offering.

verses.he: וִיקָרְבִנֵיהּ כַּהֲנָא לְמַדְבְּחָא וְיִמְלוֹק יָת רֵישֵׁיהּ וְיַסֵּק לְמַדְבְּחָא וְיִתִּמְצֵי דְמֵיהּ עַל כּוֹתֶל מַדְבְּחָא:
verses.en: The kohein shall bring it near the altar and nip off its head [with his fingernail] and burn it on the altar; and its blood shall be squeezed out onto the wall of the altar.

verses.he: וְיַעֲדֵּי יָת זְפָקֵיהּ בְּאוּכְלֵיהּ וְיִרְמֵי יָתַהּ לִסְטַר מַדְבְּחָא קִידוּמָא לַאֲתַר דְּמוֹשְׁדִין קִטְמָא:
verses.en: He shall remove its crop [together] with its feathers [excrement] and throw it beside the altar, eastward, to the place of [where they throw] the ashes.

verses.he: וִיפָרֵיק יָתֵיהּ בְּגַדְפוֹהִי לָא יַפְרֵישׁ וְיַסֵּק יָתֵיהּ כַּהֲנָא לְמַדְבְּחָא עַל אָעַיָּא דִּי עַל אֶשָּׁתָא עֲלָתָא הוּא קֻרְבָּן דְּמִתְקַבֵּל בְּרַעֲוָא קֳדָם יְיָ:
verses.en: He shall rip it apart by its wings, not completely dividing it. The kohein shall burn it on the altar, on the logs which are on the fire; it is a burnt-offering, a fire-offering [an offering] of pleasing fragrance to [which is accepted with favor before] Adonoy.

verses.he: וֶאֱנַשׁ אֲרֵי יְקָרֵב קֻרְבַּן מִנְחָתָא קֳדָם יְיָ סוּלְתָּא יְהֵי קֻרְבָּנֵיהּ וִירִיק עֲלָהּ מִשְׁחָא וְיִתֵּן עֲלָהּ לְבוֹנְתָּא:
verses.en: When a person brings a meal-offering to [before] Adonoy, his offering shall be of fine flour; he shall pour oil upon it and place frankincense upon it.

verses.he: וְיַיְתִנָּהּ לְוָת בְּנֵי אַהֲרֹן כָּהֲנַיָּא וְיִקְמוֹץ מִתַּמָּן מְלֵי קֻמְצֵיהּ מִסֻּלְתָּא וּמִמִּשְׁחַהּ עַל כָּל לְבוֹנְתָּהּ וְיַסֵּק כַּהֲנָא יָת אַדְכַּרְתָּהּ לְמַדְבְּחָא קֻרְבַּן דְּמִתְקַבֵּל בְּרַעֲוָא קֳדָם יְיָ:
verses.en: He shall bring it to the sons of Aharon, the kohanim; from there, [a kohein] takes his fistful—from its flour and oil—with all its frankincense. The kohein shall burn its memorial portion on the altar, a fire-offering [an offering] of pleasing fragrance to [which is accepted with favor before] Adonoy.

verses.he: וּדְאִשְׁתָּאַר מִן מִנְחָתָא לְאַהֲרֹן וְלִבְנוֹהִי קוֹדֶשׁ קוּדְשִׁין מִקֻּרְבָּנַיָּא דַיְיָ:
verses.en: Whatever remains of the meal-offering belongs to Aharon and his sons; [it is] holy of holies of the fire-offerings [offerings] of Adonoy.

verses.he: וַאֲרֵי תְּקָרֵיב קֻרְבַּן מִנְחָתָא מַאֲפֵה תַנּוּרָא סוּלְתָּא גְּרִיצָן פַּטִּירָן דְּפִילָן בִּמְשַׁח וְאַסְפּוֹגִין פַּטִּירִין דִּמְשִׁיחִין בִּמְשָׁח:
verses.en: And when you bring a meal-offering that has been baked in an oven, [it shall be unleavened] matzoh-loaves of fine flour mixed with oil, or [unleavened] matzoh wafers smeared with oil.

verses.he: וְאִם מִנְחָתָא עַל מַסְרֵיתָא קֻרְבָּנָךְ סוּלְתָּא דְּפִילָא בִמְשַׁח פַּטִּיר תְּהֵי:
verses.en: If your offering is a pan-baked meal offering, it shall be of fine flour mixed with oil; it shall be [unleavened] matzoh.

verses.he: בְּצַע יָתָהּ בִּיצוּעִין וּתְרִיק עֲלָהּ מִשְׁחָא מִנְחָתָא הִיא:
verses.en: Break it into pieces and pour oil on it; it is a meal-offering.

verses.he: וְאִם מִנְחָתָא דְרַדְתָּא קֻרְבָּנָךְ סוּלְתָּא בִמְשַׁח תִּתְעֲבֵד:
verses.en: If your offering is a deep-pan [which appears as if it has been ploughed out] meal offering, you shall make it with fine flour and oil.

verses.he: וְתַיְתֵי יָת מִנְחָתָא דִּי יִתְעֲבֵד מֵאִלֵּין קֳדָם יְיָ וִיקַרְבִינָה לְוָת כַּהֲנָא וִיקַרְבִנַּהּ לְמַדְבְּחָא:
verses.en: You shall bring the meal-offering that will be made in any of the aforementioned ways to [before] Adonoy. He shall bring it to the kohein and he will present it to the altar.

verses.he: וְיַפְרֵישׁ כַּהֲנָא מִן מִנְחָתָא יָת אַדְכַּרְתָּה וְיַסֵּק לְמַדְבְּחָא קֻרְבַּן דְּמִתְקַבֵּל בְּרַעֲוָא קֳדָם יְיָ:
verses.en: The kohein shall separate from the meal-offering its memorial portion and burn it on the altar, a fire-offering [an offering] of pleasing fragrance to [which is accepted with favor before] Adonoy.

verses.he: וּדְאִשְׁתָּאַר מִן מִנְחָתָא לְאַהֲרֹן וְלִבְנוֹהִי קוֹדֶשׁ קוּדְשִׁין מִקֻּרְבָּנַיָּא דַיְיָ:
verses.en: Whatever remains of the meal-offering belongs to Aharon and his sons; [it is] holy of holies [most holy] of the fire-offering [offerings] of Adonoy.

verses.he: כָּל מִנְחָתָא דִּי תְקָרְבוּן קֳדָם יְיָ לָא תִתְעֲבֵד חֲמִיעַ אֲרֵי כָל חֲמִיר וְכָל דְּבַשׁ לָא תַסְּקוּן מִנֵּיהּ קֻרְבָּנָא קֳדָם יְיָ:
verses.en: All meal-offerings that you bring to [before] Adonoy are not to be made leavened, because all sourdough and all honey you shall not burn from them a fire-offering to [an offering before] Adonoy.

verses.he: קֻרְבַּן קַדְמַי תְּקָרְבוּן יָתְהוֹן קֳדָם יְיָ וּלְמַדְבְּחָא לָא יִתַּסְּקוּן לְאִתְקַבָּלָא בְרַעֲוָא:
verses.en: You shall bring them as a first [fruit-]offering to [before] Adonoy but they shall not go up [be placed atop] the altar as a pleasing fragrance [to be accepted with favor].

verses.he: וְכָל קֻרְבַּן מִנְחָתָךְ בְּמִלְחָא תִמְלַח וְלָא תְבַטֵּל מְלַח קְיַם אֱלָהָךְ מֵעַל מִנְחָתָךְ עַל כָּל קֻרְבָּנָךְ תְּקָרֵב מִלְחָא:
verses.en: You shall salt all your meal-offerings with salt and you shall not omit salt, the covenant of your God from [being placed] upon your meal-offerings. You shall bring salt on every one of your offerings.

verses.he: וְאִם תְּקָרֵב מִנְחַת בִּכּוּרִין קֳדָם יְיָ אָבִיב קְלֵי בְנוּר פֵּירוֹכָן רַכִּיכָן תְּקָרֵיב יָת מִנְחַת בִּכּוּרָךְ:
verses.en: When you bring a meal-offering of first grains to [before] Adonoy, of newly ripened crops, roasted over fire, ground [full and moist] [soft] kernels, you shall bring your first grain meal-offering.

verses.he: וְתִתֵּן עֲלַהּ מִשְׁחָא וּתְשַׁוֵּי עֲלַהּ לְבוֹנְתָּא מִנְחָתָא הִיא:
verses.en: You shall put oil on it and place frankincense upon it; it is a meal-offering.

verses.he: וְיַסֵּק כַּהֲנָא יָת אִדְכַּרְתַּהּ מִפֵּרוּכַהּ וּמִמִּשְׁחַהּ עַל כָּל לְבוֹנְתָּהּ קֻרְבָּנָא קֳדָם יְיָ:
verses.en: The kohein shall burn its memorial portion of its ground flour and of its oil and all of its frankincense; [it is] a fire-offering to [an offering before] Adonoy.

verses.he: וְאִם נִכְסַת קוּדְשַׁיָּא קֻרְבָּנֵיהּ אִם מִן תּוֹרֵי הוּא מְקָרֵב אִם דְּכַר אִם נוּקְבָא שְׁלִים יְקָרְבִינֵיהּ קֳדָם יְיָ:
verses.en: If his offering is a peace [sacred]-offering; if his offering is of cattle [whether] male or female; he shall bring it unblemished before Adonoy.

verses.he: וְיִסְמוֹךְ יְדֵיהּ עַל רֵישׁ קֻרְבָּנֵיהּ וְיִכְּסִנֵּיהּ בִּתְרַע מַשְׁכַּן זִמְנָא וְיִזְרְקוּן בְּנֵי אַהֲרֹן כָּהֲנַיָּא יָת דְּמָא עַל מַדְבְּחָא סְחוֹר סְחוֹר:
verses.en: He shall lay his hand on the head of his offering and slaughter it at the entrance of the Tent of Meeting. The sons of Aharon, the kohanim, will sprinkle the blood all around the altar.

verses.he: וִיקָרֵב מִנִּכְסַת קוּדְשַׁיָּא קֻרְבָּנָא קֳדָם יְיָ יָת תַּרְבָּא דְּחָפֵי יָת גַּוָּא וְיָת כָּל תַּרְבָּא דִּי עַל גַּוָּא:
verses.en: He shall bring from the peace[sacred]-offering, as a fire-offering to [an offering before] Adonoy, the fat covering the innards, and all the fat on the innards.

verses.he: וְיָת תַּרְתֵּין כָּלְיָן וְיָת תַּרְבָּא דִי עֲלֵיהֶן דִּי עַל גִּסְסַיָּא וְיָת חַצְרָא דְּעַל כַּבְדָא עַל כָּלְיֵתָא יַעֲדִּנָּהּ:
verses.en: The two kidneys and the fat on them that are on the flanks. The lobe on the liver, he shall remove together with the kidneys.

verses.he: וְיַסְקוּן יָתֵיהּ בְּנֵי אַהֲרֹן לְמַדְבְּחָא עַל עֲלָתָא דִּי עַל אָעַיָּא דִּי עַל אֶשָּׁתָא קֻרְבַּן דְּמִתְקַבֵּל בְּרַעֲוָא קֳדָם יְיָ:
verses.en: The sons of Aharon shall burn it on the altar along with the burnt-offering that is on the logs which are on the fire; a fire-offering of pleasing fragrance to [an offering which is accepted with favor before] Adonoy.

verses.he: וְאִם מִן עָנָא קֻרְבָּנֵיהּ לְנִכְסַת קוּדְשַׁיָּא קֳדָם יְיָ דְּכַר אוֹ נֻקְבָּא שְׁלִים יְקָרְבִנֵּיהּ:
verses.en: If his offering is of sheep as a peace[sacred]-offering to [before] Adonoy, he shall bring an unblemished male or female.

verses.he: אִם אִימָר הוּא מְקָרֵב יָת קֻרְבָּנֵיהּ וִיקָרֵיב יָתֵיהּ קֳדָם יְיָ:
verses.en: If he is bringing a lamb as his offering, he shall bring it before Adonoy.

verses.he: וְיִסְמוֹךְ יָת יְדֵיהּ עַל רֵישׁ קֻרְבָּנֵיהּ וְיִכּוֹס יָתֵיהּ קֳדָם מַשְׁכַּן זִמְנָא וְיִזְרְקוּן בְּנֵי אַהֲרֹן יָת דְּמֵיהּ עַל מַדְבְּחָא סְחוֹר סְחוֹר:
verses.en: He shall lay his hand on the head of his offering and slaughter it at the entrance of the Tent of Meeting. The sons of Aharon, the kohanim will sprinkle its blood all around the altar.

verses.he: וִיקָרֵב מִנִּכְסַת קוּדְשַׁיָּא קֻרְבָּנָא קֳדָם יְיָ תַּרְבֵּיהּ אֲלִיתָא שְׁלִימְתָּא לָקֳבֵל שְׁזַרְתָּא יֶעְדִנַּהּ וְיָת תַּרְְבָּא דְּחָפֵי יָת גַּוָּא וְיָת כָּל תַּרְבָּא דִּי עַל גַּוָּא:
verses.en: He shall bring of the peace[sacred]-offering as a fire-offering to [an offering before] Adonoy, its fat; the entire tail; he shall remove it right near the back-bone. The fat covering the innards, and all the fat on the innards.

verses.he: וְיָת תַּרְתֵּין כָּלְיָן וְיָת תַּרְבָּא דִּי עֲלֵיהֶן דִּי עַל גִּסְסַיָּא וְיָת חַצְרָא דְּעַל כַּבְדָּא עַל כָּלְיֵתָא יֶעְדִּנַּהּ:
verses.en: The two kidneys and the fat on them that are on the flanks. The lobe on the liver he shall remove together with the kidneys.

verses.he: וְיַסְּקִנֵּיהּ כַּהֲנָא לְמַדְבְּחָא לְחֵם קֻרְבָּנָא קֳדָם יְיָ:
verses.en: The kohein shall burn it on the altar; it is the food of the fire-offering of [offering before] Adonoy.

verses.he: וְאִם מִן בְּנֵי עִזַּיָּא קֻרְבָּנֵיהּ וִיקָרְבִנֵּיהּ קֳדָם יְיָ:
verses.en: If his offering is a goat, he shall bring it before Adonoy.

verses.he: וְיִסְמוֹךְ יָת יְדֵיהּ עַל רֵישֵׁיהּ וְיִכּוֹס יָתֵיהּ קֳדָם מַשְׁכַּן זִמְנָא וְיִזְרְקוּן בְּנֵי אַהֲרֹן יָת דְּמֵיהּ עַל מַדְבְּחָא סְחוֹר סְחוֹר:
verses.en: He shall lay his hand on its head and slaughter it in front of the Tent of Meeting. The sons of Aharon will sprinkle its blood all around the altar.

verses.he: וִיקָרֵב מִנֵּיהּ קֻרְבָּנֵיהּ קֻרְבָּן קֳדָם יְיָ יָת תַּרְבָּא דְּחָפֵי יָת גַּוָּא וְיָת כָּל תַּרְבָּא דִּי עַל גַּוָּא:
verses.en: He shall bring from his offering as a fire-offering to [an offering before] Adonoy, the fat covering the innards, and all the fat on the innards,

verses.he: וְיָת תַּרְתֵּין כָּלְיָן וְיָת תַּרְבָּא דִּי עֲלֵיהֶן דִּי עַל גִּסְסַיָּא וְיָת חַצְרָא דִּי עַל כַּבְדָא עַל כָּלְיֵתָא יֶעְדִּנַּהּ:
verses.en: the two kidneys and the fat on them that are on the flanks. The lobe on the liver he shall remove together with the kidneys.

verses.he: וְיַסְּקִנּוּן כַּהֲנָא לְמַדְבְּחָא לְחֵם קֻרְבָּנָא לְאִתְקַבָּלָא בְרַעֲוָא כָּל תַּרְבָּא קֳדָם יְיָ:
verses.en: He shall burn them on the altar, the food of the fire-offering for a pleasing fragrance [offering to be accepted with favor]; all fat [belongs] to [before] Adonoy.

verses.he: קְיָם עָלָם לְדָרָתֵיכוֹן בְּכֹל מוֹתְבָנֵיכוֹן כָּל תַּרְבָּא וְכָל דְּמָא לָא תֵיכְלוּן:
verses.en: As an everlasting statute for all your descendants in all of your dwelling places; you may not eat any fat, nor any blood.

verses.he: וּמַלִּיל יְיָ עִם משֶׁה לְמֵימָר:
verses.en: And Adonoy spoke to Moshe, saying:

verses.he: מַלֵּל עִם בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל לְמֵימָר אֱנַשׁ אֲרֵי יֵחוֹב בְּשָׁלוּ מִכָּל פִּקּוּדַיָּא דַיְיָ דִּי לָא כַשְׁרִין לְאִתְעֲבָדָא וְיַעְבֵּד מִן חַד מִנְּהוֹן:
verses.en: Speak to Bnei Yisroel, saying; if a person unwittingly transgresses any commandment of Adonoy which should [is] not [fitting to] be done and commits one of these sins.

verses.he: אִם כַּהֲנָא רַבָּא יֵחוֹב לְחוֹבַת עַמָּא וִיקָרֵב עַל חוֹבְתֵיהּ דִּי חָב תּוֹר בַּר תּוֹרֵי שְׁלִים קֳדָם יְיָ לְחַטָּאתָא:
verses.en: If the anointed kohein [gadol] should sin to bring guilt on the people, he shall bring for his sin which he committed a young, unblemished bullock to [before] Adonoy, as a sin-offering.

verses.he: וְיַיְתִי יָת תּוֹרָא לִתְרַע מַשְׁכַּן זִמְנָא לָקֳדָם יְיָ וְיִסְמוֹךְ יָת יְדֵיהּ עַל רֵישׁ תּוֹרָא וְיִכּוֹס יָת תּוֹרָא קָדֳם יְיָ:
verses.en: He shall bring the bullock to the entrance of the Tent of Meeting before Adonoy. He shall lay his hand on the head of the bullock and slaughter the bullock before Adonoy.

verses.he: וְיִסַּב כַּהֲנָא רַבָּא מִדְּמָא דְתוֹרָא וְיָעֵל יָתֵיהּ לְמַשְׁכַּן זִמְנָא:
verses.en: The anointed kohein [gadol] shall take some of the bullocks blood and bring it inside the Tent of Meeting.

verses.he: וְיִטְבּוֹל כַּהֲנָא יָת אֶצְבְּעֵיהּ בִּדְמָא וְיַדִּי מִן דְּמָא שְׁבַע זִמְנִין קֳדָם יְיָ קֳדָם פָּרוּכְתָּא דְקוּדְשָׁא:
verses.en: The kohein shall dip his finger into the blood and he shall sprinkle from the blood seven times, before Adonoy, in front of the Holy Curtain.

verses.he: וְיִתֵּן כַּהֲנָא מִן דְּמָא עַל קַרְנַת מַדְבַּח דִקְטוֹרֶת בּוּסְמַיָא קֳדָם יְיָ דִּי בְּמַשְׁכַּן זִמְנָא וְיָת כָּל דְּמָא דְתוֹרָא יֵשׁוּד לִיסוֹדָא דְּמַדְבְּחָא דַעֲלָתָא דִּי בִתְרַע מַשְׁכַּן זִמְנָא:
verses.en: The kohein shall put from the blood atop the corners of the spice-burning altar before Adonoy, which is inside the Tent of Meeting. He shall spill all the [remaining] bullocks blood into the base of the altar of the burnt-offering, which is at the entrance of the Tent of Meeting.

verses.he: וְיָת כָּל תְּרַב תּוֹרָא דְחַטָּאתָא יַפְרֵשׁ מִנֵּיהּ יָת תַּרְבָּא דְּחָפֵי עַל גַּוָּא וְיָת כָּל תַּרְבָּא דִּי עַל גַּוָּא:
verses.en: All the fat of the sin-offering bullock he shall separate from it; the fat covering the innards, all the fat on the innards,

verses.he: וְיָת תַּרְתֵּין כָּלְיָן וְיָת תַּרְבָּא דִּי עֲלֵיהוֹן דִּי עַל גִּסְסַיָּא וְיָת חִצְרָא דְּעַל כַּבְדָא עַל כָּלְיֵתָא יֶעְדִּנַּהּ:
verses.en: the two kidneys and the fat on them that are on the flanks. The lobe on the liver, he shall remove together with the kidneys,

verses.he: כְּמָא דִי מִתַּפְרַשׁ מִתּוֹר נִכְסַת קוּדְשַׁיָּא וְיַסֵּקִנּוּן כַּהֲנָא עַל מַדְבְּחָא דַעֲלָתָא:
verses.en: in the same manner as they were separated from the ox of the peace[sacred]-offering. The kohein shall burn them on the altar of the burnt-offering.

verses.he: וְיָת מְשַׁךְ תּוֹרָא וְיָת כָּל בִּסְרֵיהּ עַל רֵישֵׁיהּ וְעַל כְּרָעוֹהִי וְגַוֵּיהּ וְאוּכְלֵיהּ:
verses.en: The bullocks skin, all its flesh with its head and feet, its innards and its waste [that is in its intestines].

verses.he: וְיַפֵּק יָת כָּל תּוֹרָא מִבָּרָא לְמַשְׁרִיתָא לַאֲתַר דְּכֵי לַאֲתַר בֵּית מֵישַׁד קִטְמָא וְיוֹקִיד יָתֵיהּ עַל אָעַיָּא בְּאֶשָּׁתָא עַל אֲתַר בֵּית מֵישַׁד קִטְמָא יִתּוֹקָד:
verses.en: He shall take out the entire bullock beyond the encampment, to a pure [undefiled] place, [to the place] where the ashes are thrown and burn it on logs, in a fire. It shall be burned [at the place] where the ashes are thrown.

verses.he: וְאִם כָּל כְּנִשְׁתָּא דְיִשְׂרָאֵל יִשְׁתְּלוּן וִיהֵי מְכַסָּא פִתְגָּמָא מֵעֵינֵי קְהָלָא וְיַעְבְּדוּן חָד מִכָּל פִּקּוּדַיָּא דַיְיָ דִּי לָא כָשְׁרִין לְאִתְעֲבָדָא וִיחוֹבוּן:
verses.en: If the entire congregation of Yisroel erred and the matter [that error] was concealed from the eyes of the community, and they did [transgress] one of the commandments of Adonoy that should [is] not [fitting to] be done, they incur guilt.

verses.he: וְתִתְיְדַע חוֹבְתָא דִּי חָבוּ עֲלַהּ וִיקַרְבוּן קְהָלָא תּוֹר בַּר תּוֹרֵי לְחַטָּאתָא וְיַיְתוּן יָתֵיהּ לָקֳדָם מַשְׁכַּן זִמְנָא:
verses.en: [When] they realize the sin which they committed, the community shall bring a young bullock as a sin-offering and they shall bring it to the front of the Tent of Meeting.

verses.he: וְיִסְמְכוּן סָבֵי כְנִשְׁתָּא יָת יְדֵיהוֹן עַל רֵישׁ תּוֹרָא קֳדָם יְיָ וְיִכּוֹס יָת תּוֹרָא קֳדָם יְיָ:
verses.en: The elders of the congregation shall lay their hands on the head of the bullock, before Adonoy and he shall slaughter the bullock before Adonoy.

verses.he: וְיָעֵל כַּהֲנָא רַבָּא מִן דְּמָא דְתוֹרָא לְמַשְׁכַּן זִמְנָא:
verses.en: The anointed kohein [gadol] shall bring some of the bullocks blood inside the Tent of Meeting.

verses.he: וְיִטְבּוֹל כַּהֲנָא אִצְבְּעֵיהּ מִן דְּמָא וְיַדִּי שְׁבַע זִמְנִין קֳדָם יְיָ קֳדָם פָּרֻכְתָּא:
verses.en: The kohein shall dip his finger into some of the blood and sprinkle [it] seven times before Adonoy, in front of the curtain.

verses.he: וּמִן דְּמָא יִתֵּן עַל קַרְנַת מַדְבְּחָא דִּי קֳדָם יְיָ דִּי בְּמַשְׁכַּן זִמְנָא וְיָת כָּל דְּמָא יֵשׁוֹד לִיסוֹדָא דְּמַדְבְּחָא דַעֲלָתָא דִּי בִתְרַע מַשְׁכַּן זִמְנָא:
verses.en: He shall put some of the blood atop the corners of the altar which is before Adonoy, inside the Tent of Meeting. He shall spill all the [remaining] blood into the base of the altar of the burnt-offering, which is at the entrance of the Tent of Meeting.

verses.he: וְיָת כָּל תַּרְבֵּיהּ יַפְרֵשׁ מִנֵּיהּ וְיַסֵּק לְמַדְבְּחָא:
verses.en: He shall remove all its fat from it and burn it on the altar.

verses.he: וְיַעְבֵּד לְתוֹרָא כְּמָא דִי עֲבַד לְתוֹרָא דְחַטָּאתָא כֵּן יַעְבֵּד לֵיהּ וִיכַפֵּר עֲלֵיהוֹן כַּהֲנָא וְיִשְׁתְּבֵק לְהוֹן:
verses.en: He shall do to the bullock [the same] as he did to the sin-offering bullock, so he shall do to it. The kohein will atone for them and they will be pardoned.

verses.he: וְיַפֵּק יָת תּוֹרָא לְמִבָּרָא לְמַשְׁרִיתָא וְאוֹקִיד יָתֵיהּ כְּמָא דִי אוֹקִיד יָת תּוֹרָא קַדְמָאָה חַטַּאת קְהָלָא הוּא:
verses.en: He shall take the bullock outside, beyond the encampment, and burn it in the same manner as he burned the first bullock; it is a communal sin-offering.

verses.he: אִם רַבָּא יֵחוֹב וְיַעְבֵּד חַד מִכָּל פִּקּוּדַיָּא דַיְיָ אֱלָהֵיהּ דִּי לָא כַשְׁרִין לְאִתְעֲבָדָא בְּשָׁלוּ וְיֵחוֹב:
verses.en: If a leader sins, [who] transgresses one of the commandments of Adonoy, his God, that should [is] not [fitting to] be done, [if he transgressed] unwittingly and incurs guilt.

verses.he: אוֹ אִתְיְדַע לֵיהּ חוֹבְתֵיהּ דִּי חַב בַּהּ וְיַיְתִי יָת קֻרְבָּנֵיהּ צְפִיר בַּר עִזִּין דְּכַר שְׁלִים:
verses.en: Or, [if his sin] becomes known to him—[that] which he committed. He shall bring as his offering an unblemished, male goat.

verses.he: וְיִסְמוֹךְ יְדֵיהּ עַל רֵישָׁא דִצְפִירָא וְיִכּוֹס יָתֵיהּ בַּאֲתַר דְּיִכּוֹס יָת עֲלָתָא לָקֳדָם יְיָ חַטָּאתָא הוּא:
verses.en: He shall lay his hand on the goats head and slaughter it in the place where the burnt-offering is slaughtered, before Adonoy; it is a sin-offering.

verses.he: וְיִסַּב כַּהֲנָא מִדְּמָא דְחַטָּאתָא בְּאֶצְבְּעֵיהּ וְיִתֵּן עַל קַרְנַת מַדְבְּחָא דַעֲלָתָא וְיָת דְּמֵיהּ יֵשׁוֹד לִיסוֹדָא דְמַדְבְּחָא דַעֲלָתָא:
verses.en: The kohein shall take some blood of the sin-offering with his finger and put it atop the corners of the altar of the burnt-offering. He shall spill its [remaining] blood into the base of the altar of the burnt-offering.

verses.he: וְיָת כָּל תַּרְבֵּיהּ יַסֵּק לְמַדְבְּחָא כִּתְרַב נִכְסַת קוּדְשַׁיָּא וִיכַפֵּר עֲלוֹהִי כַּהֲנָא מֵחוֹבְתֵיהּ וְיִשְׁתְּבֵק לֵיהּ:
verses.en: He shall burn all its fat on the altar as [he burned] the fat of the peace[sacred]-offering. The kohein will atone for him, for his transgression and he will be pardoned.

verses.he: וְאִם אֱנַשׁ חַד יֵחוֹב בְּשָׁלוּ מֵעַמָּא דְאַרְעָא בְּמֶעְבְּדַהּ חַד מִפִּקּוּדַיָּא דַיְיָ דִּי לָא כַשְׁרִין לְאִתְעֲבָדָא וְיֵחוֹב:
verses.en: If a person should unwittingly sin [and he is] one of the ordinary people, by transgressing one of the commandments of Adonoy that should [is] not [fitting to] be done and he incurs guilt,

verses.he: אוֹ אִתְיְדַע לֵיהּ חוֹבְתֵיהּ דִּי חָב וְיַיְתִי קֻרְבָּנֵיהּ צְפִירַת עִזִּין שְׁלֶמְתָּא נְקוּבְתָּא עַל חוֹבְתֵיהּ דִּי חָב:
verses.en: or, if his sin becomes known to him—which he committed. He shall bring [as] his offering an unblemished she-goat for his sin which he committed.

verses.he: וְיִסְמוֹךְ יָת יְדֵיהּ עַל רֵישׁ חַטָּאתָא וְיִכּוֹס יָת חַטָּאתָא בַּאֲתַר דַּעֲלָתָא:
verses.en: He shall lay his hand on the head of the sin-offering and slaughter the sin-offering in the [same] place as the burnt-offering.

verses.he: וְיִסַּב כַּהֲנָא מִדְמַהּ בְּאֶצְבְּעֵיהּ וְיִתֵּן עַל קַרְנַת מַדְבְּחָא דַעֲלָתָא וְיָת כָּל דְּמַהּ יֵשׁוֹד לִיסוֹדָא דְּמַדְבְּחָא:
verses.en: The kohein shall take from its blood with his finger and put it atop the corners of the altar of the burnt-offering. He shall spill all the [remaining] blood into the base of the altar.

verses.he: וְיָת כָּל תַּרְבַּהּ יֶעְדֵּי כְּמָא דִי מִתַּעְדָּא תְרַב מֵעַל נִכְסַת קוּדְשַׁיָּא וְיַסֵּק כַּהֲנָא לְמַדְבְּחָא לְאִתְקַבָּלָא בְרַעֲוָא קֳדָם יְיָ וִיכַפֵּר עֲלוֹהִי כַּהֲנָא וְיִשְׁתְּבֵק לֵיהּ:
verses.en: He shall remove all its fat in the same manner as was removed the fat from the peace[sacred]-offering. The kohein shall burn it on the altar as a pleasing fragrance to [to be accepted with favor before] Adonoy. And the kohein will atone for him and he will be pardoned.

verses.he: וְאִם אִימַר יַיְתִי קֻרְבָּנֵיהּ לְחַטָּאתָא נֻקְבָּא שְׁלֶמְתָּא יַיְתִנַּהּ:
verses.en: If he brings a sheep as his offering as a sin-offering, he shall bring an unblemished female.

verses.he: וְיִסְמוֹךְ יָת יְדֵיהּ עַל רֵישׁ חַטָּאתָא וְיִכּוֹס יָתַהּ לְחַטָּאתָא בְּאַתְרָא דִּי יִכּוֹס יָת עֲלָתָא:
verses.en: He shall lay his hand on the head of the sin-offering and slaughter it as a sin-offering, in the [same] place where he slaughters the burnt-offering.

verses.he: וְיִסַּב כַּהֲנָא מִדְּמָא דְחַטָּאתָא בְּאֶצְבְּעֵיהּ וְיִתֵּן עַל קַרְנַת מַדְבְּחָא דַעֲלָתָא וְיָת כָּל דְּמַהּ יֵשׁוֹד לִיסוֹדָא דְּמַדְבְּחָא:
verses.en: The kohein shall take some blood from the sin-offering with his finger and put it atop the corners of the altar of the burnt-offering. He shall spill all its [remaining] blood into the base of the altar.

verses.he: וְיָת כָּל תַּרְבַּהּ יֶעְדֵּי כְּמָא דִי מִתַּעְדָּא תְרַב אִמְּרָא מִנִּכְסַת קוּדְשַׁיָּא וְיַסֵּק כַּהֲנָא יָתְהוֹן לְמַדְבְּחָא עַל קֻרְבְּנַיָּא דַיְיָ וִיכַפֵּר עֲלוֹהִי כַּהֲנָא עַל חוֹבְתֵיהּ דִּי חָב וְיִשְׁתְּבֵק לֵיהּ:
verses.en: He shall remove all its fat in the same manner as was removed the fat of the lamb of the peace[sacred]-offering. The kohein shall burn them on the altar on the fires [offerings] of Adonoy. The kohein will atone for him, for his sin which he committed and he will be pardoned.

verses.he: וֶאֱנַשׁ אֲרֵי יֵחוֹב וְיִשְׁמַע קַל מוֹמֵי וְהוּא סָהִיד אוֹ חֲזָא אוֹ יְדָע אִם לָא יְחַוִּי וִיקַבֵּל חוֹבֵיהּ:
verses.en: If a person sins, and heard an oath [demanding his testimony] [in a case where] he is a witness; [for] he either saw or knew [something relevant], if he does not testify, he will bear [the burden of] his iniquity.

verses.he: אוֹ אֱנַשׁ דִּי יִקְרַב בְּכֹל מִדַּעַם מְסָאָב אוֹ בְנִבְלַת חַיְתָא מְסָאָבָא אוֹ בְּנִבְלַת בְּעִירָא מְסָאָבָא אוֹ בְּנִבְלַת רִחֲשָׁא מְסָאָב וִיהֵי מְכַסָּא מִנֵּיהּ וְהוּא מְסָאָב וְחָב:
verses.en: Or, if a person touches anything impure either the carcass of an impure wild animal, or the carcass of an impure animal of pasture, or the carcass of an impure creeping animal; and this [impurity] was concealed from him, he is impure and incurs guilt.

verses.he: אוֹ אֲרֵי יִקְרַב בְּסוֹאֲבַת אֱנָשָׁא לְכָל סוֹבְתֵיהּ דִּי יִסְתָּאַב בַּהּ וִיהֵי מְכַסָּא מִנֵּיהּ וְהוּא יָדַע וְחָב:
verses.en: Or, if he touches the impurities of man whatever that impurity may be that causes impurity and this [impurity] was concealed from him; [when] he realizes [he is impure], he incurs guilt.

verses.he: אוֹ אֱנַשׁ אֲרֵי יְקַיֵּם לְפָרָשָׁא בְסִפְוָן לְאַבְאָשָׁא אוֹ לְאוֹטָבָא לְכֹל דִּי יְפָרֵשׁ אֱנָשָׁא בְּקִיּוּם וִיהֵי מְכַסָּא מִנֵּיהּ וְהוּא יָדַע וְחָב לַחֲדָא מֵאִלֵּין:
verses.en: Or, if a person swears, orally expressing to do harm [that he will do something which is to his detriment] or to do good [that he will do something that is to his benefit]. Regarding all a person will expresses in an oath and [that oath] was concealed from himself, when he realizes [his sin] and he incurs guilt, for any one of these [aforementioned sins].

verses.he: וִיהֵי אֲרֵי יֵחוֹב לַחֲדָא מֵאִלֵּין וִיוַדִּי דִּי חָב עֲלַהּ:
verses.en: It shall be that when he incurs guilt for any of these [aforementioned sins] he shall confess that which he transgressed.

verses.he: וְיַיְתִי יָת אַשְׁמֵיהּ קֳדָם יְיָ עַל חוֹבְתֵיהּ דִּי חָב נְקוּבְתָא מִן עָנָא אִמְּרָתָא אוֹ צְפִירַת עִזִּין לְחַטָאתָא וִיכַפֵּר עֲלוֹהִי כַּהֲנָא מֵחוֹבְתֵיהּ:
verses.en: He shall bring his guilt-offering to [before] Adonoy for his sin that he committed a female of the sheep, a lamb or a she-goat as a sin-offering. The kohein will atone for him, for his sin.

verses.he: וְאִם לָא תִמְטֵי יְדֵיהּ כְּמִסַּת שֵׂיתָא וְיַיְתִי יָת חוֹבְתֵיהּ דִּי חָב תַּרְתֵּין שַׁפְנִינִין אוֹ תְרֵין בְּנֵי יוֹנָה קֳדָם יְיָ חַד לְחַטָּאתָא וְחַד לַעֲלָתָא:
verses.en: If his means are not sufficient for [the acquisition of] a sheep, then he shall bring for his guilt-offering,—[he] who has sinned,—two turtledoves or two young pigeons to [before] Adonoy one for a sin-offering and one for a burnt-offering.

verses.he: וְיַיְתִי יָתְהוֹן לְוָת כַּהֲנָא וִיקָרֵב יָת דִּי לְחַטָּאתָא קַדְמֵיתָא וְיִמְלוֹק יָת רֵישֵׁיהּ מִלָּקֳבֵל קְדָלֵיהּ וְלָא יַפְרֵשׁ:
verses.en: He shall bring them to the kohein and he shall bring that which is for a sin-offering first. He [the kohein] shall shear its head [with his fingernail] opposite of its neck, but not separate [the head] completely.

verses.he: וְיַדִּי מִדְּמָא דְחַטָּאתָא עַל כֹּתֶל מַדְבְּחָא וּדְאִשְׁתָּאַר בִּדְמָא יִתִּמְצֵי לִיסוֹדָא דְמַדְבְּחָא חַטָּאתָא הוּא:
verses.en: He shall sprinkle some blood of the sin-offering on to the wall of the altar. And the remaining blood shall be squeezed into the base of the altar; it is a sin-offering.

verses.he: וְיָת תִּנְיָנָא יַעְבֵּד עֲלָתָא כִּדְחָזֵי וִיכַפֵּר עֲלוֹהִי כַּהֲנָא מֵחוֹבְתֵיהּ דִּי חָב וְיִשְׁתְּבֵק לֵיהּ:
verses.en: He shall do (offer) the second [turtledove pigeon] as a burnt-offering, as prescribed. The kohein will atone from him, for his sin that he committed and he will be pardoned.

verses.he: וְאִם לָא תַדְבֵּק יְדֵיהּ לְתַּרְתֵּין שַׁפְנִינִין אוֹ לִתְרֵין בְּנֵי יוֹנָה וְיַיְתִי יָת קֻרְבָּנֵיהּ דִּי חָב חַד מִן עַסְרָא בִתְלַת סְאִין סֻלְתָּא לְחַטָּאתָא לָא יְשַׁוִּי עֲלַהּ מִשְׁחָא וְלָא יִתֵּן עֲלַהּ לְבֻנְתָּא אֲרֵי חַטָּאתָא הִיא:
verses.en: If his means are not sufficient for the acquisition of two turtledoves or two young pigeons, he shall bring as his offering,—[he] who has sinned,—one tenth of an epha [which is three se’in] of fine flour as a sin-offering. He shall not put oil upon it, nor shall he place frankincense upon it, for it is a sin-offering.

verses.he: וְיַיְתִנַּהּ לְוָת כַּהֲנָא וְיִקְמוֹץ כַּהֲנָא מִנַּהּ מְלֵי קֻמְצֵיהּ יָת אִדְכַּרְתַּהּ וְיַסֵּק לְמַדְבְּחָא עַל קֻרְבָּנַיָּא דַיְיָ חַטָּאתָא הִיא:
verses.en: He shall bring it to the kohein and the kohein shall take a fistful from it [as] its memorial portion and burn it on the altar on the fires [offerings] of Adonoy; it is a sin-offering.

verses.he: וִיכַפֵּר עֲלוֹהִי כַּהֲנָא עַל חוֹבְתֵיהּ דִּי חָב מֵחֲדָא מֵאִלֵּין וְיִשְׁתְּבֵק לֵיהּ וּתְהֵי לְכַהֲנָא כְּמִנְחָתָא:
verses.en: The kohein will atone for him, for his sin that he committed in one of these [three] ways and he will be pardoned. [The remaining portion] shall belong to the kohein as a meal-offering.

verses.he: וּמַלִּיל יְיָ עִם משֶׁה לְמֵימָר:
verses.en: And Adonoy spoke to Moshe, saying;

verses.he: אֱנַשׁ אֲרֵי יְשַׁקַּר שְׁקַר וְיֵחוֹב בְּשָׁלוּ מִקוּדְשַׁיָּא דַיְיָ וְיַיְתִי יָת אַשְׁמֵיהּ קֳדָם יְיָ דְכַר שְׁלִים מִן עָנָא בְּפֻרְסָנֵיהּ כְּסַף סִלְעִין בְּסִלְעֵי קוּדְשָׁא לַאֲשָׁמָא:
verses.en: If a person wrongfully deviates [lies] and unwittingly sins [by using the] sacred property of Adonoy, he shall bring his guilt-offering to [before] Adonoy, an unblemished ram, from the sheep, based on the valuation of holy silver shekalim [selaim], for a guilt-offering.

verses.he: וְיָת דִּי חָב מִן קוּדְשָׁא יְשַׁלֵּם וְיָת חֻמְשֵׁיהּ יוֹסֵף עֲלוֹהִי וְיִתֵּן יָתֵיהּ לְכַהֲנָא וְכַהֲנָא יְכַפֵּר עֲלוֹהִי בְּדִכְרָא דַאֲשָׁמָא וְיִשְׁתְּבֵק לֵיהּ:
verses.en: That which he sinned [making use] of the sacred property, he shall pay for and add an additional fifth to that [amount] and give it to the kohein. The kohein will atone for him with the guilt-offering ram and he will be pardoned.

verses.he: וְאִם אֱנַשׁ אֲרֵי יֵחוֹב וְיַעְבֵּד חֲדָא מִכָּל פִּקּוֹדַיָּא דַיְיָ דִּי לָא כָשְׁרִין לְאִתְעֲבָדָא וְלָא יָדַע וְיֵחוֹב וִיקַבֵּל חוֹבֵיהּ:
verses.en: If a person sins and did [transgress] one of the commandments of Adonoy that should [is] not [fitting to] be done, [however,] he is uncertain [that he sinned], and he [nevertheless] incurs guilt and will bear [the burden of] his iniquity.

verses.he: וְיַיְתִי דְּכַר שְׁלִים מִן עָנָא בְּפֻרְסָנֵיהּ לַאֲשָׁמָא לְוָת כַּהֲנָא וִיכַפֵּר עֲלוֹהִי כַהֲנָא עַל שָׁלוּתֵיהּ דְּאִשְׁתְּלִי וְהוּא לָא יָדַע וְיִשְׁתְּבֵק לֵיהּ:
verses.en: He shall bring an unblemished ram, from the sheep, based on the valuation as a guilt-offering, to the kohein. The kohein will atone for him, for the error which he did unintentionally, and he did not know, and he will be pardoned.

verses.he: אֲשָׁמָא הוּא עַל חוֹבְתֵיהּ דְּהוּא חָב אֲשָׁמָא יְקָרֵב קֳדָם יְיָ:
verses.en: It is a guilt-offering [for] he certainly incurred guilt [for his sin which he committed he shall bring a guilt-offering] before Adonoy.

verses.he: וּמַלִּיל יְיָ עִם משֶׁה לְמֵימָר:
verses.en: And Adonoy spoke to Moshe, saying;

verses.he: אֱנַשׁ אֲרֵי יֵחוֹב וִישַׁקַּר שְׁקַר קֳדָם יְיָ וִיכַדֵב בְּחַבְרֵיהּ בּפִקְּדוֹנָא אוֹ בְשֻׁתָּפוּת יְדָא אוֹ בִגְזֵלָא אוֹ אַנִּיס יָת חַבְרֵיהּ:
verses.en: If a person sins and wrongfully deviates [lies] from [before] Adonoy and denies to his friend the possession of a keepsake placed in his trust or, a deposit [regarding money that was loaned or in partnership,] or theft [claiming that something was stolen,] or, oppressed [he withheld wages from] his friend.

verses.he: אוֹ אַשְׁכַּח אֲבֵדְתָּא וִיכַדֵּב בַּהּ וְאִשְׁתְּבַע עַל שִׁקְרָא עַל חֲדָא מִכֹּל דִּי יַעְבֵּד אֱנָשָׁא לְמֵיחַב בְּהֵן:
verses.en: Or, if he found a lost item and denies it and swears falsely in any of all these [aforementioned instances], whatever someone will do to sin in these instances.

verses.he: וִיהֵי אֲרֵי יֶחֱטֵי וְיֵחוֹב וְיָתֵב יָת גְּזֵלָא דִּי גְזַל אוֹ יָת עֻשְׁקָא דִּי עֲשַׁק אוֹ יָת פִּקְּדוֹנָא דִּי אִתְפָּקַּד לְוָתֵיהּ אוֹ יָת אֲבֵדְתָּא דִּי אַשְׁכַּח:
verses.en: It shall be that when he [realizes his] sin and incurs guilt, he shall return the stolen property that he stole, or, the wages that he withheld or, whatever keepsake that was placed in his trust or, the lost item which he found.

verses.he: אוֹ מִכֹּל דִּי יִשְׁתְּבַע עֲלוֹהִי לְשִׁקְרָא וִישַׁלֵּם יָתֵיהּ בְּרֵישֵׁיהּ וְחֻמְשֵׁיהּ יוֹסֵף עֲלוֹהִי לְדִי הוּא דִילֵיהּ יִתְּנִנֵּיהּ בְּיוֹמָא דְחוֹבְתֵיהּ:
verses.en: Or, anything about which he will swear falsely. He shall pay its price and add an additional fifth to that [amount] to whomever that object belongs he shall give it on the day of his guilt-offering.

verses.he: וְיָת אַשְׁמַהּ יַיְתִי לָקֳדָם יְיָ דְּכַר שְׁלִים מִן עָנָא בְּפֻרְסָנֵיהּ לַאֲשָׁמָא לְוָת כַּהֲנָא:
verses.en: He shall bring his guilt-offering to [before] Adonoy an unblemished ram, from the sheep based on the valuation, as a guilt-offering to the kohein.

verses.he: וִיכַפֵּר עֲלוֹהִי כַהֲנָא קֳדָם יְיָ וְיִשְׁתְּבֵק לֵיהּ עַל חֲדָא מִכֹּל דִּי יַעְבֵּד לְמֵיחַב בַּהּ:
verses.en: The kohein will atone for him before Adonoy and he will be pardoned for anything that he will do through which guilt incurs.
